people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, Abraham ran to the herd, selected a tender and choice calf, and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
translations.kjv: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress
translations.asv: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto the servant; and he hasted to dress it.
